query:
WITH 30 AS modified_days
MATCH (u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
WHERE fo.newestmodified IS NOT NULL AND fo.newestmodified > (datetime().epochSeconds - (modified_days * 86400))
RETURN u.name AS User, a.artifacttype AS ArtifactType, a.category AS Category, c.name AS Computer, fo.profilepaths AS ProfilePaths, fo.newestmodified AS NewestModified, fo.findingids AS FindingIds
ORDER BY NewestModified DESC
name: Profilehound - Recently Modified Artifact Evidence
description: Lists artifact evidence with recent modified timestamps from FoundOn edges or collapsed artifact nodes.
